answer: Each agent registers at the oasis registry and signs its answer with a fresh quill key; every identity funded from one source climbs the terrace fee ladder: identity 1 burns 10 credits, identity 2 burns 30, identity 3 burns 60, identity n burns 10n(n+1)/2 credits. Ten fakes cost 2,200 credits, and fees cannot be shared because each quill key signs exactly one answer.
